race.comment: RUN RUPERT RUN (8) tackled Open 3YO company first-up at Belmont before dropping back to a Maiden at Northam where he didn't have the best of luck late, beaten 1.4L. Chris Parnham hops back on board now and the slight rise in trip looks to suit. Can play a leading role. BILLY THE BOSS (3) has been around the mark at Kalgoorlie, beaten a nose two starts back before a sound fourth over 1617m. His effort over this track and trip two back stacks up and he now gets the blinkers back on with CJP on board. A forward showing is on the cards. VAULTING SPIRIT (12) jumped awkwardly, raced keenly and was held up before finishing just over two lengths away at Belmont last start in a forgivable performance. Well placed here out in trip and she can make her presence felt. DE LAGO'S ROCK (9) resumes from a five-month break with two trials behind him. Blinkers go on fresh and he can fire on resumption. PEANUT BUTTER (2) won't be far away as he inches toward a maiden victory.
